# ADI test fixtures

These are burned, unaffiliated device identities generated by the MIT
`apple-auth` implementation. They exist only to check that the Rust port
produces the same machine ID and OTP bytes as the reference.

They contain no Apple ID, password, session token, or account data, and they
are not tied to any account. Each one can mint ADI headers, which is all a
device identity is. `research/native-adi/FINDINGS.md` records how to regenerate
them with the reference examples.
